instruction: Verify that ~/aws-bill.pdf exists in your home directory, then insert it as an attachment into the email draft and keep the compose window open.

command: if test -f /home/user/aws-bill.pdf; then echo 'FILE_EXISTS:OK'; else echo 'FILE_EXISTS:FAIL'; fi && python /home/user/show-thunderbird-attachments.py 'New-month AWS Bill' 'aws-bill.pdf'

metadata.explanation: Task requires explicit verification of file existence before attaching to email. The evaluator combines both checks in a single command: (1) file existence check outputs FILE_EXISTS:OK/FAIL, (2) attachment verification script outputs confirmation with filename. All three patterns must be present for success.
